title: Job offer you never applied for: pay the visa fee first
hook: A recruiter says you were picked for a well-paid job you never applied for, and a visa and medical processing fee must be paid by transfer before the contract can be sent.

opening_line.voice: Hello, I am calling from an international recruitment agency. Your profile was shortlisted for a supervisor role paying AED 18,000 a month with housing.
opening_line.whatsapp: Hello, I am a recruiter with an international hiring agency. Your profile was shortlisted for a supervisor role paying AED 18,000 a month with housing, are you available to talk?
opening_line.email: Congratulations, you have been selected for a senior position with a monthly salary of AED 18,000 plus allowances. Please reply today so we can start your visa processing and send your contract.
opening_line.sms: Recruitment team: you have been shortlisted for a well-paid job in the UAE. Reply today to confirm your interest before the position is filled.

stage_goals.PRETEXT: Introduce yourself as a recruiter who found the person's profile and says they were shortlisted for a well-paid position with housing and transport allowances
stage_goals.PRESSURE: Say other candidates are waiting and the offer closes today unless the visa and medical processing fee of AED 1,500 is paid so the contract can be issued
stage_goals.ASK: Say the finance team will share the transfer details for the processing fee, then ask the commit question

commit_question: Are you ready to transfer the processing fee today so we can send your contract?
commit_signals: i can pay the fee today
where do i send the money
red_flags: A job offer for a role you never applied for
A fee must be paid before you get a contract
Pressure to decide today or lose the job

lesson.headline: A real employer never asks you to pay to get hired
three_points: In the UAE the employer pays for your visa and medical test, not you. Any request for a fee before a contract is a warning sign.
Check the company yourself using contact details you find on your own, not the ones the recruiter gives you.
A salary that is too good and an offer you never applied for are bait. Stop replying and report the message.
lesson.report_to: contact the Aman service of Abu Dhabi Police

opening_line.voice: مرحبا، معاك وكالة توظيف دولية. ملفك انختار لوظيفة مشرف براتب 18,000 درهم في الشهر مع سكن.
opening_line.whatsapp: مرحبا، معاك موظف توظيف من وكالة توظيف دولية. ملفك انختار لوظيفة مشرف براتب 18,000 درهم في الشهر مع سكن، فاضي نتكلم؟
opening_line.email: مبروك، انختاريت لوظيفة عالية براتب 18,000 درهم في الشهر مع بدلات. رد علينا اليوم عشان نبدا إجراءات الفيزا ونرسل لك العقد.
opening_line.sms: فريق التوظيف: انختاريت لوظيفة براتب زين في الإمارات. رد اليوم وأكد اهتمامك قبل لا تنشغل الوظيفة.

ar.commit_question: إنت جاهز تحوّل رسوم الإجراءات اليوم عشان نرسل لك العقد؟
red_flags: عرض وظيفة ما قدّمت عليها أصلاً
لازم تدفع رسوم قبل لا يوصلك العقد
ضغط عشان تقرر اليوم وإلا تروح عليك الوظيفة

lesson.headline: صاحب الشغل الحقيقي ما يطلب منك تدفع عشان يوظفك
three_points: في الإمارات صاحب الشغل هو اللي يدفع الفيزا والفحص الطبي، مب إنت. أي طلب رسوم قبل العقد علامة خطر.
تأكد من الشركة بنفسك من أرقام تلقاها إنت، مب الأرقام اللي يعطيك إياها الموظف.
الراتب الوايد زين والعرض اللي ما قدّمت عليه طُعم. وقّف الرد وبلّغ عن الرسالة.
lesson.report_to: تواصل مع خدمة أمان في شرطة أبوظبي
